Logging._comment: Console is deliberately quiet so the ReviewProgressReporter's stage lines stand out (picked -> setup -> reviewing -> done). This filter is CONSOLE-ONLY; the opt-in JSONL sink (CodeReviewDaemon:LogFilePath) keeps full Debug detail for DuckDB. SingleLine collapses each entry to one readable line.

CodeReviewDaemon._comment_StrandedRun: A dropped PR resumes without a daemon restart (#317): StrandedRunReconciler sweeps on the poll's cadence and hands any non-terminal run — RetryPending included — back to the orchestrator once it has sat untouched past the grace period. The knobs below are stated at their defaults so an operator can see and tune them rather than having to read the source to discover they exist.
CodeReviewDaemon._comment_StrandedRunGraceHours: Hours a non-terminal run must sit untouched before the reconciler takes it over. 0 disables the reconciler entirely. Must stay comfortably above ReviewStageDeadlineMinutes so a live run is never caught mid-stage.
CodeReviewDaemon._comment_StrandedRunScanLimit: Most stranded rows one pass READS from the store; rows beyond it are picked up by the following pass.
CodeReviewDaemon._comment_StrandedRunMaxResumesPerSweep: Most stranded runs one pass actually RESUMES. Deliberately small: a backlog built up over weeks must not become a burst of concurrent reviews — and, on a posting daemon, a burst of comments — the first time this runs. Deferred runs are logged, never dropped.
